details:
1. Join one instance

2. Presented with a black screen

3. Fails and retries

4. Forced into another instance without prior permission

The specific problem is as follows:

I was joining some friends in Popcorn Palace. When trying to join, the black fade did not go away, the game appeared to freeze, and then it went back to the loading screen. After the second loading screen, I was able to get into the instance. However, it was not the instance that was intended.

The instance I joined was a different instance. The instance was a `Friends Only` instance who had a friend of mine in it (who also created the instance), and they were on orange. I was never invited to this instance and should never have been able to access it in the first place. 

Attached are censored logs of the problem.

Additional Info:

1. I also know there is a way to gain access to instances if someone was *previously* on Green, but then swapped to Orange, using VRCX. To my knowledge, this gives the person permission to join even if they weren't invited. But this wasn't the case based on my VRCX logs, as this person was Orange the entire time.

2. I am currently using WiFi that is not very stable. I presume this was the trigger that caused this problem to happen, however, I was able to repeat this problem immediately after the first time it happened. I also was forced into the default VRChat home after trying to go back to my home world in the same way.
title: Forced into private world without permission via bugged instance (security concern)
